body:
GREG, 2026-11-15 about 20:46Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1303, message 0bead8bb), verbatim: „co do memories, stare wersje NIE powinny byc pokazywa, bo to psuje info agentowi, z czasem moze mu sie pomieszac”.
REQUIREMENT, for both projects (Asistant's brief, a paraphrase):
- Ordinary listing, search, recovery and reads for an agent show ONLY the current, valid version of a memory.
- Earlier versions don't enter the ordinary agent context. History appears only on a deliberate, explicit choice.
- The request does NOT ask for history deletion or a sync-format change.
- Check Engram and TermAl, including after sync; name every violation and fix it. Kimi checks independently. Sync and EO continue.
Fable's first read of master 50862fce: memory query search joins memory_heads on the head version with status active (project_memory/read.rs:344–365), so it shows only current versions. Listing shows the current first line. `memories KEY --full` shows the current revision, but its next hints offer `--revision N-1`, which is a nudge toward old versions to review. Not yet checked: the global `search` verb, recovery and peek digests, and TermAl's injected context.
